#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long pow10[16];

int solve(long long x) {
    if (x <= 11) {
        if (x == 11) return 2;
        else if (x == 10) return 3;
        else if (x == 9) return 4;
        else if (x == 8) return 5;
        else if (x == 7) return 6;
        else return (int)x;
    }
    int len = to_string(x).length();
    long long boof = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= len; i++) boof += pow10[i];
    int res = INT_MAX;
    if (x > boof - x)
        res = min(res, len + 1 + solve(boof - x));
    boof -= pow10[len];
    for (int d = 1; d <= 9; d++) {
        boof *= d;
        if (d == x / pow10[len-1] || d + 1 == x / pow10[len-1])
            res = min(res, len * d + solve(abs(boof - x)));
        boof /= d;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    pow10[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 15; i++) pow10[i] = pow10[i-1] * 10;
    string input;
    cin >> input;
    long long start = stoll(input);
    cout << solve(start) << endl;
    return 0;
}
